_readme: Backstage instance config. Copy to ~/.backstage/config.json (or point BACKSTAGE_CONFIG at it).
Every field is optional: a missing/invalid file (or any missing key) falls back to the built-in defaults, which are the values shown here.

Precedence per key: env var -> config.json -> built-in default. Env overrides: HOST, PORT, WEBHOOK_PORT, MICHAEL_UI_BASE (publicBaseUrl), PREVIEW_HOST, BACKSTAGE_CLAUDE_BIN, BACKSTAGE_OPENCODE_BIN, BACKSTAGE_WORKTREES_DIR, BACKSTAGE_MCP_CONFIG, BACKSTAGE_TELLA_FUSION (repos.tella-fusion.repo).

repos: an entry whose id matches a built-in overrides just the fields it sets; a new id (needs at least `repo`) adds a repo. `default: true` marks the repo sessions target when none is specified (falls back to tella-fusion). `previewCommand` is the dev-server bring-up script; `depsInstall` is a shell command run in a fresh worktree to install dependencies (unset = built-in behavior).

identity.team derives commit attribution, per-user MCP gating, and human-ask routing. Omit `identity` entirely to keep the built-in roster; an empty team disables those features (they no-op). `linearEmails` are the person's Linear account emails; `githubToSlack: false` keeps someone out of GitHub-event Slack pings. `identity.slackNames` adds Slack id -> display name entries for bots/legacy ids that aren't full team members.
The `integrations` and `policy` sections are parsed but NOT applied yet (upcoming portability batches); they are documented here so configs written now keep working.

persona.name IS applied: it is the agent's name as rendered to users and models (system prompts, Slack greetings, confirm cards, health payloads). Protocol identifiers (michael-* MCP server ids, MICHAEL_* env vars, ===MICHAEL-SUMMARY=== markers) are NOT affected. persona.company/persona.product are parsed but not yet wired.

branding.productName/productMark name the platform itself in user-facing copy (page titles, headers; mark = short monogram for the logo chip). Paths and ids (~/.backstage-*, BACKSTAGE_*, bks-, service names) are NOT affected — see docs/rename-opensession-plan.md.
